audience.title: Who telepace can talk to for you.

inbox.title: Everything that needs a human.
inbox.itemBody1: Interview 048 flagged distress signals — auto-closed. Review the transcript before dismissing.
inbox.itemBody2: New theme surfaced: '$79 feels punitive without SSO' (confidence 0.82, 11 supporting quotes).
inbox.itemBody3: Reached 24 / 24 completions. Study auto-closes tomorrow unless you extend it.
inbox.itemBody4: Weekly digest is ready — 3 studies progressed and 2 new themes surfaced.

insights.title: Themes, across every study.
insights.emptyDescription: Themes surface here once your studies start collecting responses.
insights.theme1Quote1: If SSO were included I wouldn't even blink at the price. Right now it feels like I'm paying to be inconvenienced.
insights.theme1Quote2: Every other tool at this price gives you Okta. It's table stakes.
insights.theme1Quote3: $79 with SSO = fine. $79 without = starting to look at competitors.
insights.theme2Title: Onboarding stops mid-flow after email confirmation
insights.theme2Quote1: I confirmed my email and… nothing. I forgot about it for two days.
insights.theme2Quote2: The email said 'you're in' but the app didn't seem to know that.
insights.theme3Title: The MCP hook is the reason for the upgrade
insights.theme3Quote1: The MCP integration is what made me pull out the card. Everything else is table stakes.
insights.theme3Quote2: My Claude does research now. That's magic. Ten times worth $79.
insights.notionNotConnected: Notion isn't connected yet. Connect it in Integrations to push insights.
insights.notionCta: Notion integration is not set up — configure it in Integrations first.
insights.dismissedEmpty: All insights dismissed. Reload to bring them back.

evaluationWorkbench.title: Release control workbench
evaluationWorkbench.subtitle: Every step writes a versioned event. Attach real sources, promote only reviewed claims, and compute the decision from observed trials.
evaluationWorkbench.next_done: All configured gates passed. Export the auditable Eval Pack.
evaluationWorkbench.next_evidence: Attach source evidence, review its claim, and freeze a regression.
evaluationWorkbench.next_policy: Attach the versioned account-recovery policy and name its security owner.
evaluationWorkbench.next_pairs: Attach or sample blinded clinical comparison pairs, with a protected holdout.
evaluationWorkbench.next_affected_user: Attach the triggering trace and the affected user's signed answer, then review them together.
evaluationWorkbench.next_bindings: Bind the exact production baseline and candidate versions.
evaluationWorkbench.next_trials: Record the missing paired repetitions from a real runner.
evaluationWorkbench.next_fix_candidate: Inspect the failed slice or critical candidate result before rerunning.
evaluationWorkbench.next_calibration: Record blinded expert calibration with a protected holdout.
evaluationWorkbench.savedDescription: The event, program version, and resulting HOLD/SHIP decision are durable.
evaluationWorkbench.loadError: The evaluation workbench could not be loaded.
evaluationWorkbench.evidenceSummary: {count, plural, =0 {No source artifact attached} one {# source artifact} other {# source artifacts}}
evaluationWorkbench.integrityHint: The SHA-256 digest is computed before redaction. Telepace stores the original unchanged and shows a separate redacted presentation.
evaluationWorkbench.reviewSummary: {claims, plural, =0 {No reviewed claims} other {# claims}} · {regressions, plural, =0 {no regressions} one {# regression} other {# regressions}}
evaluationWorkbench.noArtifacts: Attach a source before reviewing a claim.
evaluationWorkbench.artifactLinkHint: Select every source that jointly supports the claim. Trace-linked clarification should include both the trace and affected-user answer.
evaluationWorkbench.assertion: Exact claim supported by this source
evaluationWorkbench.frozenInputHint: Leave empty to freeze the attached source content as the replay input.
evaluationWorkbench.trialsSummary: {count, plural, =0 {No observed repetitions} one {# observed repetition} other {# observed repetitions}}
evaluationWorkbench.trialIntegrityHint: Telepace does not fabricate a run. A runner URI and both observed outputs are required for every repetition.

evaluationWorkbench.calibrationIntegrityHint: Use at least 10 decisions and keep at least 2 as holdout. Valid verdicts: a, b, tie, pass, fail.

copilot.title: Research copilot
copilot.subtitle: Ask questions across all your studies.
copilot.noStudiesDescription: Create and run at least one study to use the copilot.
copilot.loadError: Your studies could not be loaded.
copilot.answer1: Across the studies you selected, pricing friction is the dominant theme. In {studies}, respondents repeatedly tie the $79 tier to a lack of SSO — the objection shows up in 11 of 34 completed interviews.
copilot.answer2: Two of the studies point the same direction: onboarding stalls after email confirmation. The pattern in {studies} suggests people never receive a clear next step, so activation drops within 48 hours.
copilot.answer3: Comparing {studies}, the MCP integration is the strongest expansion driver — it's the single feature respondents cite unprompted when explaining why they upgraded.
copilot.answer4: Synthesizing {studies}: churned users and active power-users describe the same gap. The difference is timing — power-users hit the wall later, which buys you a window to intervene.
